comparison.objective: Read an analog clock and set a digital bedside clock, versus tune a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual time interpretation and counted button presses versus precision hex-tool work, collar control, and physical cycle evaluation.
comparison.success_condition: Digital time reaches 4:39–4:41, with partial credit for correct minutes, versus two mechanically safe stops and a stable locked adjustment.
comparison.reason: Only generic control actuation is shared. No spec versions are present; button travel and actuation-force thresholds are omitted.
